title: Tyrannosaurus rex
text:
T. rex


Period: Late Cretaceous
Length: ~12 meters
Interesting fact: T. rex had the strongest bite force of any terrestrial animal.



Massive skull balanced by a long, heavy tail
Binocular vision
Two-fingered forelimbs

title: Quetzalcoatlus
text:
Period: Late Cretaceous
Wingspan: ~10–11 meters
Interesting fact: One of the largest known flying animals of all time.



Long neck and beak
Toothless jaws
Possibly capable of launching from the ground
